descriptor.name: PMFBY grievance desk
descriptor.longDesc: Files a grievance against a PMFBY enrolment and reads a filed case.

categories.name: Enrollment / Portal Issues
categories.help: Something about your enrolment, or about the portal itself, is not working.

subCategories.name: Login
subCategories.help: You cannot sign in to the portal to see your enrolment.

actions.description: File a new grievance. Needs the enrolment number, the applicant's mobile, the crop year, the season and a description of the problem. Returns case.ticketNo, which status requires. Needs no OTP, so it can be called without init.

Read where a filed grievance stands: its status code, the portal's reply and the crop it concerns. Needs case.ticketNo from an earlier support call, plus the applicant's mobile. Cases cannot be listed by enrolment number, so support must come first.

Ask PM-KISAN to send a four-digit OTP to the mobile registered against this enrolment number. Needs only the enrolment number. Call before status or support: both require challenge.response carrying this OTP.

Read a grievance already filed against this enrolment number: its status code, the officer's reply and when it was given. Needs the OTP from init and case.filedOn, the filing date support returned, which picks one case out of all those on the registration.

File a new grievance against this enrolment number, under one of the categories published above. Needs the OTP from init. Returns case.ticketNo and case.filedOn; keep filedOn, because status selects a case by it.
